deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: To embed a returns reason capture form in Shopify, follow these steps:
1. Go to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Online Store" > "Themes".
2. Click on the "Actions" dropdown menu next to your current theme and select "Edit code".
3. In the code editor, navigate to the "templates" folder and open the "cart.liquid" file.

4. Add the following code snippet to the bottom of the file: <form id="returns-reason-form" method="post" action="/api/returns-reason"> <label for="reason">Reason for return:</label> <input type="text" id="reason" name="reason" required> <button type="submit">Submit</button> </form> <script> const form = document.getElementById('returns-reason-form'); form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const reason = document.getElementById('reason').value; fetch('/api/returns-reason', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ reason: reason }) }) .then((response) => response.json()) .then((data) => console.log(data)) .catch((error) => console.error(error)); }); </script>
5. Save the changes to the "cart.liquid" file.
6. Go to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Payment providers".
7. Click on the "Add payment provider" button and select "API" as the payment provider type.
8. Enter the API endpoint URL for your returns reason capture form and click "Save".
9. Test the returns reason capture form by navigating to your store's cart page and submitting the form.
